Submission Guide

How to Apply for a Tender

Follow these four steps to submit a complete and compliant tender bid.

01

Identify Tender

Browse active tender listings and identify opportunities matching your company's capabilities and registration categories.

02

Download Documents

Download the complete tender document package including BOQ, specifications, terms and conditions from the tender reference page.

03

Prepare Submission

Prepare your technical and financial proposal according to the tender requirements. Ensure all mandatory documents are included.

04

Submit Bid

Submit your completed tender via the designated method (online portal or physical submission) before the stated closing date.

Who Can Apply

Eligibility Criteria

To participate in ATLINE tender exercises, bidding companies must meet the following minimum requirements.

Valid SSM / ROB / ROC company registration
MOF registration (for government tenders)
Relevant CIDB grade (where applicable)
Proven track record in ICT infrastructure works
Minimum workforce capability per tender scope
Financial capacity evidenced by bank statements

Common Questions

Tender FAQs

How do I get notified of new tenders?

Register as an ATLINE approved supplier through our Procurement portal. Registered suppliers receive direct email notifications for all new tender invitations matching their service categories.

Is there a tender deposit or participation fee?

Selected tenders may require a tender document fee or performance bond. All requirements are detailed in the individual tender document. Most routine tenders carry no participation fee.

Can foreign companies participate?

Government-related tenders are open to Malaysian-registered companies only, in compliance with MAMPU and MOF guidelines. Private sector tenders may accept foreign entities — refer to individual tender conditions.

What is the typical evaluation period?

Evaluation typically takes 4–8 weeks after tender closing date, depending on complexity. Shortlisted bidders will be contacted for clarification or presentation if required.
